title: Dispensing with the Use (of Means)
chinese: 反者道之动，弱者道之用。
天下万物生于有，有生于无。
pinyin: Fǎn zhě dào zhī dòng， ruò zhě dào zhī yòng。
Tiān xià wàn wù shēng yú yǒu， yǒu shēng yú wú。
english: The movement of the Tao Tao By contraries proceeds; And weakness marks the course Of Tao’s mighty deeds. Tao’s
All things under heaven sprang from It as existing (and named); that existence sprang from It as nonexistent (and not named).
